claims.quote: the Scottish Government is one of the most centralised devolved administrations in Europe
claims.statement: The Scottish Government is one of the most centralised devolved administrations in Europe.

claims.quote: Holyrood not giving people who know their areas best enough of a say
claims.statement: The Scottish Parliament does not give people who know their areas best enough of a say.

claims.quote: Through No10 North, we are rewiring the state
claims.statement: Through No10 North, the UK Government is rewiring the state.

claims.quote: With us working together, there is no limit to what we can achieve for the Scottish people.
claims.statement: Working together, the Prime Minister and the First Minister can achieve without limit for the Scottish people.

claims.quote: Devolution has done a great deal
claims.statement: Devolution has done a great deal.

claims.quote: People in North Lanarkshire, in Fife or in the Highlands know what their communities need better than any minister
claims.statement: People in North Lanarkshire, Fife and the Highlands know what their communities need better than any minister.

claims.quote: the Scotland Office is ready to roll up its sleeves alongside them
claims.statement: The Scotland Office is ready to work alongside the Scottish Government to make the Prime Minister's offer happen.

entities.name: Andy Burnham
entities.role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

facts.quote: Delivering his remarks after speaking with young people today in Lanarkshire
facts.statement: Andy Burnham spoke with young people in Lanarkshire on 2026-10-15 before delivering his remarks.

facts.quote: I told the First Minister that I wanted to work with him to spread opportunities to communities across Scotland’s regions and cities.
facts.statement: Andy Burnham told the First Minister in his first week in office that he wanted to work with him to spread opportunities across Scotland's regions and cities.

facts.quote: he will call on the Scottish Government to work with the UK Government through No10 North and the Scotland Office
facts.statement: Andy Burnham will call on the Scottish Government to work with the UK Government through No10 North and the Scotland Office to develop a new model of regional empowerment for Scotland.

facts.quote: This is me making an offer to the Scottish Government.
facts.statement: Andy Burnham made an offer to the Scottish Government.

facts.statement: Douglas Alexander, the Scottish Secretary, made a statement on the Prime Minister's offer to the Scottish Government.
